stem: While introducing a woman named Kavya to others, Rajan says: 'Her mother's only sister is my father's only sister.' How is Kavya related to Rajan?

per_option_rationale.rationale: Kavya's mother's only sister = Rajan's father's only sister, so Kavya's mother and Rajan's father are siblings; their children are first cousins.
Treats Kavya as one generation below Rajan (as if she were Rajan's sibling's daughter) instead of the same generation.
Inverts the direction: concludes Kavya belongs to the parent generation when she is in Rajan's own generation.
Reaches the correct generation (cousin-level) but applies the male gendered term to Kavya, who is female.

explanation: Rajan's father's only sister = Kavya's mother's only sister. This means Kavya's mother and Rajan's father are siblings (they share the same sister). A child of your parent's sibling is your first cousin, so Kavya is Rajan's cousin.
